title: Independence-System Realisations in Single-Source Unsplittable Flow
abstract: arXiv:2609.17568v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Additive-congestion constraints in single-source unsplittable flow can enforce stable-set structure. This note isolates and generalises that mechanism. We introduce a path-closed notion of realising an independence system by the zero-cost choices of primary terminals in a directed acyclic flow instance. The definition quantifies over every directed source-terminal path and therefore remains valid under prefix borrowing, suffix splicing, and hybrid routes.Our main result extends the triangle mechanism: every finite loopless independence system has a polynomial-size realisation, measured in the incidence size of its minimal forbidden sets. Hence every finite simple graph, and more generally every hypergraph independence system without singleton forbidden hyperedges, is representable by an acyclic single-source gadget. We then specialise the construction to odd cycles. For C_{2k+1}, a uniform rational family produces a fractional cheap-se

translated_title: 单源不可分裂流中的独立系统实现
translated_abstract: 单源不可分裂流中的加性拥塞约束能够强制实现稳定集结构。本简报分离并推广了这一机制。我们引入了一种路径封闭的概念，即通过有向无环流实例中主终端的零成本选择来实现独立系统。该定义对每条有向的源到终端路径进行全称量化，因此在前缀借用、后缀拼接和混合路由下依然有效。我们的主要结果扩展了三角形机制：每个有限的无环独立系统都拥有一个多项式规模的实现，其规模以最小禁用集的关联规模来度量。因此，每个有限简单图，以及更一般地，每个不含单元素禁用超边的超图独立系统，都可以由一个无环单源小装置来表示。随后，我们将该构造专门化到奇圈上。对于 C_{2k+1}，一个一致的有理数族产生了一个分数的廉价……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明了每个有限无环独立系统都可以通过无环单源不可分裂流构造以多项式规模实现，从而将强制稳定集结构的三角形机制推广到一般的独立系统，包括所有有限简单图及不含单元素禁用超边的超图独立系统。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that every finite loopless independence system admits a polynomial-size realisation as an acyclic single-source unsplittable flow gadget, thereby generalising the triangle mechanism that enforces stable-set structure via additive-congestion constraints to all finite simple graphs and hypergraph independence systems without singleton forbidden hyperedges.
